relevance_rank_note: Human iPSC microglia, APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3. The paper studies lysosomes and pinocytosis (excluded in round 4 on those readouts), but its baseline proteome (Table S4, author-published log2 fold changes and p values) lists the WASH endosomal recycling complex, LRP1, SORL1 and the transferrin receptor as lower in APOE4/4. Total protein only, class 3; the APOE4/4 arm is two lines from one background.

quote: Differentially expressed proteins in APOE 4/4 iMGs as compared to E3/3 in basal conditions.
system: Human iPSC-derived microglia (iMGs), untreated (basal). Six APOE3/3 lines (sample labels E3/3_2, _3, _5, _6, _7 and a PLCG2-edited E3/3_5 line) vs two APOE4/4 lines that the authors call isogenic to each other (labels E4/4_5 and E4/4_5_PLCG2, i.e. one genetic background with and without a PLCG2 edit). Label-free whole-cell proteomics (Perseus), Student's t-test, unadjusted p; Table S4 lists proteins with p < 0.05 and at least 2-fold change.
description: All five detected WASH complex subunits, the endosomal actin machinery that drives retromer-dependent recycling of surface receptors, were lower in APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 human iPSC microglia at baseline. Recorded value is WASHC4: log2 fold change -1.148 (about 55% lower), p 6.3e-05. The others: WASHC5 -1.124 (p 7.4e-05), WASHC3 -1.122 (p 2.0e-04), WASHC2A -0.995 and -1.060 (two protein groups, p 2.8e-04 and 4.4e-04), WASH6P -1.250 (p 4.8e-04).
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4, human iPSC microglia) -> (less WASH recycling complex protein)
location: Table S4 (Supplementary Material 2), row WASHC4; other WASH rows in the same table
human_check: Printed log2 fold change and p reproduced exactly from the per-sample LFQ columns with an unpaired Student's t-test (APOE4/4 minus APOE3/3). Effect = percent change converted from the printed log2 fold change. n = 8 samples (6 APOE3/3, 2 APOE4/4); the APOE4/4 arm is one genetic background, so genotype is confounded with donor. One row for the complex, using its lowest-p subunit, so five subunits of one complex are not counted as five findings.
